title: Fury dominates Wach in Thailand boxing bout ahead of Joshua showdown
summary: Boxer Tyson Fury defeated Dillian Wach in a boxing match in Thailand, with Fury's victory setting up his upcoming fight against Anthony Joshua. The match took place on March 12 at the Siam Park Hotel in Bangkok. Fury won by technical knockout in the 10th round. Fury's trainer, Sugar Hill Steward, claimed that Fury was 'in control' throughout the fight. Fury's next fight is scheduled for April 23 against Joshua.

Fury won by technical knockout in the 10th round.
